description: All Docker services start healthy and the backend returns a valid health check response
steps: Run: docker compose up -d
Wait ~30s, then run: docker compose ps
Verify all 6 containers show status 'Up' or 'healthy'
Run: curl http://localhost:8000/health
Verify response contains {"status":"ok"}

description: Database migrations run successfully and all 11 tables exist with correct schema
steps: Run: docker compose exec backend alembic upgrade head
Run: docker compose exec postgres psql -U aitracker -d aitracker -c '\dt'

Verify all 11 tables exist: sources, articles, article_contents, article_fingerprints, article_scores, recipients, daily_reports, report_versions, report_sections, email_deliveries, job_execution_logs

description: Default news sources are seeded into the database (12 sources)
steps: Run: docker compose exec backend python scripts/seed_sources.py
Run: curl http://localhost:8000/api/v1/sources/
Verify response contains at least 12 sources

description: Admin can view the dashboard summary with today's article counts and report status
steps: Run: curl http://localhost:8000/api/v1/dashboard/summary
Verify response includes fields: articles_today, total_articles, pending_reports, active_recipients, last_collection_at
Verify HTTP 200 response

description: Admin can list and add news sources (RSS feeds and NewsAPI)
steps: Run: curl http://localhost:8000/api/v1/sources/
Verify HTTP 200 and list of sources returned
Run: curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/v1/sources/ -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"name":"Test RSS","source_type":"rss","feed_url":"https://example.com/feed.xml","enabled":true}'
Verify HTTP 201 and the new source is returned with an ID
Run: curl http://localhost:8000/api/v1/sources/ and verify the new source appears

description: Admin can manually trigger article collection and see articles stored in the database
steps: Ensure at least one enabled source exists
Run: curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/v1/jobs/run/collect
Verify HTTP 200 and job_id returned
Wait 10s, then run: curl http://localhost:8000/api/v1/jobs/logs?limit=5
Verify job log shows status=success for collect job
Run: curl http://localhost:8000/api/v1/articles/ and verify articles exist

description: Article deduplication via SimHash correctly identifies and marks duplicate articles
steps: Trigger collection: curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/v1/jobs/run/collect
Trigger collection again: curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/v1/jobs/run/collect
Run: curl 'http://localhost:8000/api/v1/articles/?is_duplicate=true'
Verify duplicate articles are marked with is_duplicate=true
Run unit tests: docker compose exec backend pytest tests/test_analyzers.py -v

description: Admin can manage newsletter subscribers (add, list, import CSV)
steps: Run: curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/v1/recipients/ -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"email":"test@example.com","name":"Test User"}'
Verify HTTP 201 returned
Run: curl http://localhost:8000/api/v1/recipients/ and verify the new subscriber appears
Create a CSV file with headers email,name and 2 rows, then POST to /api/v1/recipients/import/csv
Verify all subscribers were imported

description: Admin can manually trigger GPT-4o newsletter generation and view the generated report
steps: Ensure at least 5 articles exist in the database
Run: curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/v1/jobs/run/report
Verify HTTP 200 and job_id returned
Wait for completion, then run: curl http://localhost:8000/api/v1/reports/
Verify a report exists with status=draft or ready
Run: curl http://localhost:8000/api/v1/reports/<id> and verify html_content is populated

description: Admin can approve a report before sending
steps: Ensure a report exists with status=ready
Run: curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/v1/reports/<id>/approve
Verify HTTP 200 returned
Run: curl http://localhost:8000/api/v1/reports/<id>
Verify report status changed to approved

description: Admin can send a test email to a single address to preview the newsletter
steps: Ensure a report exists and SMTP credentials are configured in .env
Run: curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/v1/deliveries/test-send -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"report_id": 1, "test_email": "<your-email>"}'
Verify HTTP 200 returned
Check the target email inbox for the newsletter

description: Admin can send the newsletter to all active subscribers
steps: Ensure at least one active subscriber and an approved report exist
Run: curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/v1/deliveries/send -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"report_id": 1}'
Verify HTTP 200 returned
Run: curl http://localhost:8000/api/v1/jobs/logs?limit=5 and verify send job shows success
Check subscriber email inbox

description: Admin can view 7-day article trend analytics
steps: Run: curl http://localhost:8000/api/v1/analytics/trends/last7
Verify HTTP 200 returned
Verify response includes daily breakdown with article counts and categories

description: Admin can compare two reports to see what changed between them
steps: Ensure at least 2 reports exist
Run: curl 'http://localhost:8000/api/v1/analytics/diff?report_id_a=1&report_id_b=2'
Verify HTTP 200 returned
Verify response includes added/removed/modified sections

description: Frontend dashboard page loads and displays real-time stats from the backend
steps: Open browser at http://localhost:3000
Verify the dashboard page loads without errors
Verify articles_today, total_articles, and other stats are displayed
Verify the sidebar navigation links are visible and clickable

description: Frontend articles page displays a filterable, paginated list of collected articles
steps: Navigate to http://localhost:3000/articles
Verify list of articles is displayed with title, source, category, and date
Apply a filter (e.g., by category) and verify the list updates
Verify pagination controls work correctly

description: Frontend sources page allows adding and toggling news sources
steps: Navigate to http://localhost:3000/sources
Verify list of sources is displayed
Toggle a source on/off and verify the change is reflected
Add a new source via the form and verify it appears in the list

description: Frontend recipients page allows managing subscribers including CSV import
steps: Navigate to http://localhost:3000/recipients
Verify subscriber list is displayed
Add a new subscriber via the form
Use drag-and-drop to import a CSV file with multiple subscribers
Verify all imported subscribers appear in the list

description: Frontend reports page shows report list with approval workflow and HTML preview
steps: Navigate to http://localhost:3000/reports
Verify list of reports is displayed with status badges
Click on a report to view the HTML content preview
Approve a report using the Approve button
Verify status changes to approved

description: Frontend analytics page shows 7-day trend charts
steps: Navigate to http://localhost:3000/analytics
Verify trend chart is rendered with data for the last 7 days
Verify category breakdown is shown

description: Celery Beat scheduler is configured with correct UTC schedule for all 3 daily tasks
steps: Run: docker compose exec backend python -c "from app.workers.celery_app import celery_app; import json; print(json.dumps({k: str(v) for k,v in celery_app.conf.beat_schedule.items()}, indent=2))"
Verify 3 tasks are scheduled: collect (22:00 UTC), report (23:00 UTC), send (00:00 UTC)
Check Beat logs: docker compose logs beat --tail=20
Verify Beat log shows 'Scheduler: Sending due task' messages

description: Backend test suite passes with >= 80% line coverage
steps: Run: docker compose exec backend pytest tests/ -v --cov=app --cov-report=term-missing
Verify 0 test failures
Verify coverage >= 80%
